name: Hello World
description: A minimal example module demonstrating a basic Drupal module (Hello World).
project_description:
Hello World! 
 Introduction 
 "Hello World!" example in Drupal.

An example Drupal module with a controller.

 Requirements 
 The module does not have any specific requirements.

 Installation 
 Install as you would normally install a Drupal module.

 Please download and install through Drupal Admin UI Area or use

 composer require drupal/helloworld 

then enable the example "Hello World" Drupal module.

 Drupal core version dependencies 
 
 Please use the latest stable version for Drupal core >= 8.7.7 version. 
 Please use 8.x-1.2 version for Drupal core <= 8.7.6 version. 
 
 Configuration 
 The "Hello World" module does not need any specific configuration. After the enabling of module you will directly see the new main menu link "Hello World" and just click on it. That is all.
